entry.title: Connor Hellebuyck Starts His Devils Debut at Dallas: 'He Is Going Tonight'
entry.summary: Sheldon Keefe confirmed Connor Hellebuyck starts Tuesday at Dallas, four days after the trade from Winnipeg. Casey DeSmith starts for the Stars. New Jersey plays at Colorado on Wednesday.

entry.title: Dan Vladar Starts for the Flyers Against Columbus, With a Back-to-Back in Washington Next
entry.summary: Rick Tocchet confirmed Dan Vladar will start Tuesday against Cam Talbot and the Blue Jackets. Philadelphia plays at Washington on Wednesday, and no starter has been named for that game.

entry.title: Adin Hill Starts for Vegas Against Ottawa After Carter Hart Is Hurt at the Morning Skate
entry.summary: Carter Hart was injured at Vegas' morning skate and is being evaluated, NHL.com reports, so Adin Hill starts Tuesday against Ottawa. Jonas Johansson starts for the Senators.

entry.title: NHL Starting Goalies Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026: Capitals on a Back-to-Back, Red Wings' Postava Question
entry.summary: Thursday has 11 NHL games and no starters reported yet. Washington is on the second night of a back-to-back, and Detroit has not said whether Michal Postava keeps the net.

entry.title: Rangers Pull James Reimer After One Period of His Debut; Dylan Garand's Workload Stays the Story
entry.summary: James Reimer allowed three goals on eight shots in his first Rangers start and was replaced by Dylan Garand in a 6-3 loss to the Kings. Mike Sullivan took the blame. New York does not play again until Sunday.

entry.title: Michal Postava Wins His First NHL Start, Stopping McDavid, Draisaitl and Nugent-Hopkins in the Shootout
entry.summary: Red Wings rookie Michal Postava made 25 saves and went 3-for-3 in the shootout in a 4-3 win at Edmonton. Detroit hosts Chicago on Thursday, and the team has not said who starts.

entry.title: Connor Hellebuyck Says He Is Ready for His Devils Debut; Tuesday Starter at Dallas Not Named
entry.summary: Connor Hellebuyck practiced with New Jersey for the first time Monday and said he could play today. Coach Sheldon Keefe wants him involved on the three-game trip but is taking it day by day.

entry.title: Flames' Devin Cooley Has Started Three Straight Wins Before Maple Leafs Visit
entry.summary: Devin Cooley has started each of Calgary's three straight wins ahead of Monday's game with Toronto. Here is where both creases stand before any starter is announced.

entry.title: NHL Starting Goalies Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026: Hellebuyck Debuts, Adin Hill In for Vegas
entry.summary: All 22 Tuesday starters are now reported: 12 confirmed and 10 expected. Connor Hellebuyck debuts for New Jersey, and Adin Hill starts for Vegas after Carter Hart was hurt at the morning skate.

entry.title: NHL Starting Goalies Wednesday, Oct. 28: Logan Thompson Probable for Capitals; Devils on a Back-to-Back
entry.summary: Wednesday has four NHL games and no announced starters yet. NHL.com lists Capitals goalie Logan Thompson as probable to return, and New Jersey plays the second half of a back-to-back at Colorado.

entry.title: Oilers Goalies Without Devon Levi: Tristan Jarry and Matt Tomkins Before Red Wings Game
entry.summary: With Devon Levi on injured reserve, Edmonton has Tristan Jarry and recalled Matt Tomkins for Monday's game against Detroit. Neither team has named a starter yet.

entry.title: Rangers Add James Reimer as Dylan Garand's Workload Grows Before Kings Game
entry.summary: The Rangers signed 38-year-old James Reimer on Sunday, a day before hosting the Kings. Here is what is known about Monday's crease and what has not been announced.

entry.title: Red Wings Turn to Michal Postava for His First NHL Start at Edmonton; Jarry in Goal for Oilers
entry.summary: Detroit coach Todd McLellan named 24-year-old Michal Postava as Monday's starter at Edmonton, his first NHL start. The Oilers announced Tristan Jarry for the home side.

entry.title: Canucks Project Leevi Merilainen vs. Wild as Quinn Hughes Returns, Oct. 25, 2026
entry.summary: Leevi Merilainen is projected to start for Vancouver against Minnesota on Sunday after Kevin Lankinen played Thursday. Calvin Pickard is confirmed for the Wild.

entry.title: Islanders Expect Ilya Sorokin vs. Jake Oettinger in Dallas, Oct. 25, 2026
entry.summary: The Islanders' own game preview says Ilya Sorokin is expected to start at Dallas on Sunday, against an expected Jake Oettinger. Neither start had been officially confirmed when we published.

entry.title: Jets Goalie for Heritage Classic: Skinner or Stevenson After Hellebuyck Trade; Canadiens Starter Not Announced
entry.summary: Winnipeg plays its first game since trading Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey with Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson as its two NHL goalies. Neither the Jets nor the Canadiens had confirmed a Heritage Classic starter in the sources we checked.

entry.title: NHL Starting Goalies Monday, Oct. 26, 2026: Kings-Rangers, Leafs-Flames, Red Wings-Oilers
entry.summary: Monday evening update: James Reimer, Sergei Bobrovsky, Devin Cooley, Michal Postava and Tristan Jarry are confirmed, and Darcy Kuemper is expected for the Kings.

entry.title: NHL Starting Goalies Tonight (Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026): Schmid, Knight and Pickard Confirmed; Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner Expected
entry.summary: Five NHL games Sunday. Akira Schmid and Spencer Knight started in Chicago, and Calvin Pickard is confirmed for Minnesota. Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner, Wedgewood, Annunen and Merilainen are expected.

entry.title: Panthers Confirm Akira Schmid in Goal at Blackhawks Tonight; Blackhawks Expected to Turn to Soderblom
entry.summary: Florida confirms Akira Schmid starts Sunday at Chicago with Jacob Markstrom injured. NHL.com projects Arvid Soderblom for Chicago after Spencer Knight's five straight starts.

entry.title: Predators Close Back-to-Back vs. Avalanche After Saros' 34-Save Night in Pittsburgh
entry.summary: Nashville hosts Colorado on the second night of a back-to-back after Juuse Saros played Saturday in Pittsburgh, and the team is skipping its morning skate. Neither club has confirmed a starter.

entry.title: Wild Confirm Calvin Pickard Starts at Canucks Tonight on Back-to-Back
entry.summary: Minnesota coach John Hynes split the weekend back-to-back: Jesper Wallstedt started Saturday at Seattle and Calvin Pickard starts Sunday in Vancouver. The Canucks have not confirmed their goalie.
